description: §5.2 rule 2, S457 bullet `srcdoc` in every form: the variable form `srcdoc=@doc` puts data into an HTML document and is refused (s462-bootstrap-sink-guards — the S462 reproduction: on the bootstrap this compiled clean and, in Chromium, the frame ran the cell's script).
rationale: §5.2 rule 2 (S457): "A `srcdoc` attribute (any case) on an element whose value is not a static string — the expression form `srcdoc=${…}`, a variable `srcdoc=@doc` / `srcdoc=it.html`, a call `srcdoc=f()`, … — SHALL be a compile error (E-ATTR-INTERP-EXECUTABLE)".
